title: SD1 NEU Quarter tVS-RC
wikitext:
[[Image:SD EU.gif|right|SD EU Logo]] == Introduction == * Competition: [[SD NEU Season 1|Smackdown North Europe 1]] * Round: Quarterfinals * Match: [[The Viper Squad]] vs [[Inner Circle]] * Date: 06-10-2000 == Screenshots == === DM2 === [[Image:SD1_NEU_Quarter_tVS-RC_dm2.jpg]]

After the usual server issues which were sorted out quite fast this time the match got underway on a german server that gave fair pings to both teams. First map was TVS's choice dm2. During the first minute after start both teams struggled for control but soon TVS locked the map down. Until the 10 minute mark they build up a huge lead. Halfway through the map RC started a comeback and locked down the map for about five minutes closing the gap. TVS then got in control again and never gave it back winning with a quite huge margin. === DM3 === [[Image:SD1_NEU_Quarter_tVS-RC_dm3.jpg]]

Second map would be dm3 where TVS got a very good start in getting pent/rl/lg. They fragged the RC quad at ra before it could do any serious damage and locked down the map early on. RC fought back but gained nothing but a few frags here and there. TVS never lost control and won with a hug margin. The only noteable thing here is that after about 5 minutes RC discovered that discharge was turned off which annoyed them a bit but they kept on playing anyway.
